subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:**

P. He took great care to remove the old, flaking paint from the antique table.

Q. He smoothed the wood using fine sandpaper to bring out the original grain.

R. He added a final layer of varnish for protection and a new stain.

S. The table had been carefully refurbished and was no longer worn out and ancient.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. P, Q, R, S .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence parts describe a sequential process of refurbishing an antique table.
 
• Option '3' i.e., P, Q, R, S is the correct order as it logically arranges the steps in the process:
 
 
• **P:** Removing the old, flaking paint is the first step.
 
• **Q:** Smoothing the wood with fine sandpaper is the next step to bring out the original grain.
 
• **R:** Adding varnish and a new stain follows as the final touch for protection and aesthetics.
 
• **S:** The concluding statement summarizes the result of the refurbishment process.
 

Correct arrangement: *P, Q, R, S*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This type of question tests your ability to logically sequence ideas or events.
 
• Pay attention to the context and keywords in each sentence part to determine the correct chronological or logical order.
 
• Practice with similar questions to improve your comprehension and sequencing skills.
